{"metadata":{"identifier":"kdtu2009-03-26.flac16.4ch","creator":"Karl Denson's Tiny Universe","title":"Karl Denson's Tiny Universe Live at The Double Door on 2009-03-26","venue":"The Double Door","coverage":"Chicago, IL","description":"Karl Denson's Tiny Universe, The Double Door, Chicago, IL, 2009-03-26

4 channel audience matrix of:

Neumann km184's(FOB 25'/DFC/~7.5' high) > MOTU Ultralite mk3 > PC(Sonar 7/16bit/48kHz)
Neumann km84i's(FOB 25'/DFC/~7.5' high, [X/Y] 2 inches below km184's on the same pole) > Sound Devices 722 > MOTU Ultralite mk3 > PC(Sonar 7/16bit/48kHz)

>> Mixed On PC(Sonar 7/16-Bit/48kHz) > CDWave(tracking) > FLAC(16-Bit/44.1-kHz/Level 8)

km184's Source Recorded By: John F.
km84i's Source Recorded By: taperjoe
Mixing By: John F.

Set 1
=====
1. Intro
2. Sister Janie
3. Groovy Thing >
4. Freedom
5. Cool Is Back
6. We Got To Understand
7. The Grunt >
8. Straussmania
9. Because Of Her Beauty

Set 2
=====
1. Once You're There
2. Crowd / Banter
3. Soul Driftin' >
4. Family Tree
5. Steamed Water
6. Wil Blades Intro
7. Rumpwinder*
8. Crowd / Banter
9. Satisfied
10. Chicago Breakdown$
11. Bougainvillea
12. Callback / Banter
Encore
======
13. New York City

* With Wil Blades on organ
$ With Jennifer Hartswick on trumpet
Ron Haynes(Liquid Soul) also did play in the first set, I can't remeber which track.
Whole show played with Chris Stillwell(Greyboy Allstars) on bass

Notes: both sources captured to PC simultaneously, taperjoe took a master on his
722 and we patched over to my MOTU ulmk3 for a second master to mix with.

Karl Denson - sax, flute, vocals, percussion toys
Chris Littlefield - trumpet, flugelhorn, backing vocals
Brian Jordan - guitar, backing vocals
Chris Stillwell - bass
David Vleth - keyboards
Jon Staten - drums
